verdict.rationale: Glama offers a browser-based MCP Inspector that explicitly claims to test any MCP server's tools, resources, prompts, and other features directly from the browser, including a tunnel option for local servers before integration. This directly matches the story of exercising tools pre-integration. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the inspector's tool-execution UX and no community testimonial specifically about using the inspector itself (community evidence focuses on quality scoring, not the inspector).
